protocol.model: LGB 600 iterations / 63 leaves; same causal features and public-train events
hypotheses: Removing known-empty early onset cells from expert fitting improves final-step location recovery.
Independent-Bernoulli expected IoU can choose a better predicted set size than fixed probability thresholds.
protocol.inputs: Only legal history and released T rows; provided condition routes experts; no >T numeric inputs
protocol.label_source: Noisy eligible public-train observations; not underlying queue truth
protocol.selection: Calibration only; freeze before assessment loading. No assessment-driven model choice.
protocol.promotion: Require >=.01 origin-macro gain and positive day-block CI in at least two prespecified folds/directions; no assessed panel loss >.01; multiple fit seeds required.
protocol.final_test: These public-train assessment periods have already been inspected for other architectures.
